title: new records kind and priority without saying they were defaulted
claim: A task filed without --kind is recorded as kind bug with no note, while the tier default gets one; the report filed a film as a bug and saw it days later in models.
evidence: new "Film of the whole epic for the tester and the PO" on a copy of the 6.2.0 loop printed 'parsed: priority 2 · tier standard · kind bug' and a note for tier only. Map row fr-01.
proposal: Print one defaulted note per value not given (kind, priority), as for tier.

title: One model is recorded under two spellings and splits models
claim: claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5.5 are counted as two models.
evidence: Verdicts with --model claude-opus-5-5 and claude-opus-5.5 on the loop copy show as two reviewers in models; --model is stored as given. Map row fr-02.
proposal: Fold ids that differ only in '.' versus '-' when reading, say so in models, and note a new spelling of a known model on write; the log stays as written.

title: Done cannot wait for an owner's sign-off on an acceptance line
claim: An issue whose acceptance needs the owner's approval of images was set done right after its merge and had to be reopened by hand.
evidence: set 529 done passed on the loop copy with its acceptance line addressed by no row; the gate reads a Proof row and a live approve only. Map row fr-03.
proposal: Owner decision: whether done refuses while an acceptance line marked for the owner is open; issue 016 is the nearest place.

title: A batch gate cannot count for the merges it contains
claim: After the switch to local merges with batched end-to-end runs, the banner said 12 of 42 merges carry the declared check although a later gate covered every merge.
evidence: A merge carries the check only when its own --ran equals a Check line; there is no range form (help of status). Map row fr-04.
proposal: Owner decision: whether a later green check on a commit that contains a merge counts for it; if so, the banner prints that count apart.

title: A batched review is not one record
claim: Four tasks shared one review and one merge SHA, and the record shows four separate reviews.
evidence: review <ids> writes one verdict and one log line per issue with nothing linking them (help, the <ids> paragraph). Map row fr-05; issue 007 offers batches but adds no batch record.
proposal: A multi-issue verdict carries a batch id in the log, and report shows batch sizes and later rounds per batch.

title: Relayed verdicts count as fresh reviews in report and status
claim: 65 of 136 verdicts came from a pull-request bot and were counted among fresh reviewers.
evidence: --relayed exists and models counts it per reviewer, but the fresh, coordinator and self split of report and status ignores it, so a relayed approve counts as fresh and clears the gate. Map row fr-06.
proposal: Count relayed verdicts apart in report and status; the owner rules whether a bot's approve may clear an issue.

title: A stuck worker shows only after six hours without a commit
claim: Workers sat stuck on a permission prompt or idle on a shared lock while the record said in flight.
evidence: A lease is idle only after STALE_HOURS (6) with no commit on its branch; the last evidence row and log line are not read, and the threshold is a flag, not a goal line. Map row fr-07.
proposal: Show per in-flight issue the age of its last row, commit and log line, with a warning threshold in minutes set in goal.md.

title: Nothing flags a ruling that no merged issue implements
claim: Two rulings were never implemented and nobody noticed until an audit.
evidence: decide --settles writes a ruling into issues' evidence; verify lists only open issues that cite a superseded ruling. Map row fr-08.
proposal: A ruling names the issues that implement it, and verify lists rulings that require work with no done issue behind them.

title: External requirements are not tracked against the work
claim: The requirements checklist against about 30 external tickets was built by hand.
evidence: import and sources map findings to issues and their status; there is no link to evidence or rulings and no diff of a changed source. Map row fr-09.
proposal: Owner decision: whether Jarl holds requirement items; the smaller step is import reporting findings whose text changed since filing.

title: init does not ask for the Model lines
claim: The goal had no Model (<tier>) lines, so models could rank nothing.
evidence: init notes a missing Check line but not missing Model lines; models on the loop copy said the loop declares no Model lines. Map row fr-10.
proposal: init notes missing Model lines once and names goal --set "Model (<tier>): ...".

title: merged without --sha does not offer the branch head
claim: merged without --sha was refused and the line had to be retyped.
evidence: The refusal is immediate and names --sha but gives no ready command. Map row fr-11.
proposal: The refusal prints the ready command with the head of the issue's recorded branch; no silent default.

title: field with prio does not name the prio command
claim: field <id> prio fails and the right name has to be looked up in help.
evidence: field 529 prio 1 printed 'prio is not a field: Resources, or one this loop's profile declares'. Map row fr-12; issue 029 covers part of it.
proposal: The refusal names the command that writes each header field (prio, tag, files).

title: Jarl's output is English whatever the loop's language
claim: report and resume print the goal's language next to English headings and log lines.
evidence: No language setting exists in the skill or the scripts. Map row fr-13.
proposal: Owner decision: whether Jarl localises output; the cheap step is a goal line and a note on a title in another language.

title: An exact-output refactor cannot record its comparison instead of a review
claim: A 600-line refactor with byte-identical renders got a review that changed nothing.
evidence: Code closes only with a fresh approve unless a loop-wide profile setting drops review. Map row fr-14; issue 004 adds an owner's waiver by ruling.
proposal: Owner decision, inside issue 004: the waiver may name the exact-output comparison as its evidence.

title: The guidance has no rule for batching reviews
claim: Batch only tasks that share one contract or one screen, at most 4.
evidence: The references carry no batching rule. Map row fr-15; issue 007 groups by repository, tier, kind and a size.
proposal: Add one contract or one screen, at most 4, to 007's grouping and the reviewer reference.

title: The reviewer's rank does not depend on the kind of work
claim: The reviewer should be one rank above the worker for format, contract or visual work.
evidence: Review notes a same-model or lower-ranked approve, never by kind; issue 016 records the owner's rule that a reviewer is a different agent, not a different model. Map row fr-16.
proposal: Owner decision; it pulls against the rule recorded in 016.

title: resume and status end without a list of next actions
claim: After a compaction the coordinator works out the next step from about 200 lines of state.
evidence: resume prints ready issues, the merge queue and questions as separate blocks and ends with log lines. Map row fr-17.
proposal: End resume and status with at most 7 actions ordered by what they unblock, each with its command.

title: Some refusals carry no ready command
claim: Each refusal should contain the corrected command.
evidence: review without --by names the flag but gives no example line. Map row fr-18; issues 010 and 029 cover part of it.
proposal: Sweep refusals so each ends with one ready command.

title: Done's refusal after a later changes verdict names a round that was never recorded
claim: Done should refuse while a review asks for changes with no later approve.
evidence: It already refuses: approve, then changes, then set 530 done on the loop copy was refused with 'no approving review newer than its last round', though no round was recorded. Map row fr-19.
proposal: Name the later changes verdict as the cause in the refusal.

title: A commit after the approve does not spend it
claim: Done and merged should check that the evidence and the approve are newer than the last commit on the branch.
evidence: The gate's window opens at start, reopen or round, never at a commit (help of set). Map row fr-20; issue 002 records branch tips.
proposal: Owner decision: whether a commit after the approve spends it; 002's recorded tips make it checkable.

title: A coordinator under an undeclared name counts as a fresh reviewer
claim: report counted the orchestrator three times among fresh reviewers.
evidence: review 529 approve --by orchestrator was recorded as fresh and cleared the gate; only coordinator, jarl, reeve, the loop's name and a Coordinators line count as coordinator. Map row fr-22.
proposal: init and status note a loop with no Coordinators line, and the help says an undeclared name counts as fresh.

title: Status does not show who holds a shared resource and for how long
claim: Half of the watchdog checks asked by hand who held the shared container.
evidence: field <id> Resources declares exclusive resources and next never offers two issues holding one; there is no holder age. Map row fr-23.
proposal: status shows each held resource with its issue and the age of that issue's last row.

title: Reviewer, worker and takeover briefs are written by hand
claim: About 30 reviewer briefs and 2 takeover briefs were hand-written, each a chance to forget a ruling or an acceptance line.
evidence: The reviewer brief is a template in references/reviewer.md and the worker gets show pasted; no brief command. Map row fr-24; issue 020 adds a standing brief.
proposal: A brief <id> --role view built from show, earlier findings, rulings and 020's standing brief.

title: Visual review has no kind and no verdict per artifact
claim: The most valuable finds were visual, and the rule that every render gets a visual reviewer could not be enforced.
evidence: No review kind exists; attachments exist only for profile slots and not on verdicts. Map row fr-25.
proposal: Owner decision: whether a profile may require a visual verdict per tag before merged or done.

title: resume shows an answered question instead of its decision
claim: Answered asks appear as Question: lines in the rulings in force.
evidence: resume on the loop copy printed 'ask-001 · by owner — **Question:** Should 6.1.1 release...'. Map row fr-26.
proposal: resume and decisions print the answer of an ask ruling first.

title: Rulings are cut at 160 characters
claim: Each ruling is cut mid-sentence.
evidence: Both the decisions line and resume cut at 160 characters. Map row fr-27.
proposal: A ruling may carry a one-line summary written for display, printed whole.

title: resume prints every ruling in force
claim: 47 rulings print on every resume.
evidence: The loop copy printed 'Rulings in force (102)'; the whole resume was 309 lines and 41,043 bytes. Map row fr-28.
proposal: Print the rulings that touch open or in-flight issues, then a count and decisions --live.

title: A ruling cannot cite the mandate it was made under
claim: Coordinator rulings under the owner's mandate should cite it, and check should warn when one falls outside every mandate.
evidence: ask --kind ratify records a choice made under a mandate; decide has no field for the mandate. Map row fr-29.
proposal: decide --under <slug> records the mandate, and verify lists jarl rulings with none.

title: No view of what changed since a time
claim: A 15-minute watchdog re-read everything each tick.
evidence: No since command in the help. Map row fr-30.
proposal: since <time or duration> prints new log lines, moves, rows and verdicts, then the next actions.

title: report and models have no short form
claim: models printed about 40 KB where 10 lines were needed.
evidence: models --full is refused as an unknown flag; on the loop copy models was 2,115 bytes and report 109,665 bytes. Map row fr-31.
proposal: A summary first and the breakdown behind --full, for report above all.

title: The takeover limit is fixed at three rounds
claim: Format and visual work could take over after two rounds, where each round is costly to verify.
evidence: ROUNDS_BEFORE_TAKEOVER is a constant of 3. Map row fr-34.
proposal: A profile may set the round limit per kind.

title: A round records no severity
claim: A round from a wording note counts the same as one from a broken export.
evidence: A changes verdict needs a Critical or Important finding, but round is free text with no severity. Map row fr-35; issue 003 adds a count of findings.
proposal: round records the highest severity of the verdict that caused it, and report splits rounds by it.

title: The coordinator's own slips are not a statistic
claim: Closing too early or merging without the gate is invisible in report.
evidence: report counts reopenings; refused commands and reverted states are not counted. Map row fr-36.
proposal: A report section of reopens after done, retractions and refused writes by the coordinator.

title: Waiting does not show that the root cause is the owner
claim: Task 30 waits on 40, which waits on the owner, and shows only 'after 40'.
evidence: resume prints '(after 010)' style lines only. Map row fr-37.
proposal: Follow After to an open question on the owner and print 'waiting on the owner, via N'.

title: No single digest of what waits on the owner
claim: The owner reads in bursts; one message with every open question and sign-off would match that.
evidence: resume lists questions and ratify items in two blocks; no digest. Map row fr-38.
proposal: ask --digest prints open questions, ratify items and owner sign-offs in one message.

title: The CLI cannot say its version, so it can drift from the server unseen
claim: The CLI and the MCP tools could disagree on flags without an agent noticing.
evidence: The server reports the plugin's version; the CLI has no version command. Map row fr-39.
proposal: jarl.mjs --version, and resume notes when the server and the script differ.

title: Nothing re-checks a recorded attachment after done
claim: Evidence says 'rendered 73 pages' but not where they are or whether they still exist.
evidence: evidence --file --slot records path, sha256 and size and done re-checks them, only inside the loop root and only for profile slots. Map row fr-40.
proposal: verify lists recorded attachments that are gone or changed.

title: No register of what is in force or waiting on someone
claim: Standing orders, sign-offs, promises, external waits and guesses lived in chat and loose notes and were lost in compactions.
evidence: Rulings, questions, ratify items and After hold part of it; promises, external waits, validity, certainty and who holds the ball do not exist. Map row fr-41; issues 020 and 005 cover small parts.
proposal: Owner decision on the concept; loop rules (020), the owner root cause (fr-37) and the digest (fr-38) stand alone meanwhile.

title: Conflict markers and huge files pass merged and scope unnoticed
claim: Conflict markers were committed by the coordinator and a 124 MB core dump by a worker.
evidence: Neither merged nor scope checks added lines for conflict markers or added files for size. Map row fr-42.
proposal: scope and merged note added lines that start a conflict marker and added files over a size.
